page.overview:
Who is Bleu?

Bleu is a Flip-Flopian that is blue in color. He also wears a purple beret.

Bleu is an artist that lives in Flopside with his daughter Lily. Bleu speaks in a French accent. Bleu can also change Princess Peach's hairstyles but they turn back to normal once she leaves the area.
